card.name: Subscripts and numbers inside notation
card.fires_on: Small pieces inside scientific notation: a subscript or digit in AUC 24, T½, LD50, SUV mean, section numbers like (5.1), and the 2 in a percent strength. The next text is usually a closing bracket, comma or number.
